  Business-rule task "Classify transactions"
  Call activity "Submit per currency pair" → process "fx-settlement"
  End: none event "Batch complete"

processes.name: Sanctions Screening

Flow:

  Service task "Re-screen applicant" (job type "rescreen-sanctions-pep")
  → Screening complete (already described)

processes.name: Underwriting Review
processes.description:
BPMN process "Underwriting Review" (id: underwriting-review) — executable.
Contains 13 flow node(s) and 12 sequence flow(s): 1 boundaryEvent, 3 endEvent, 1 eventBasedGateway, 1 exclusiveGateway, 2 intermediateCatchEvent, 2 serviceTask, 1 startEvent, 2 userTask.
Service job types: escalate-sla-breach, handle-case-sla-breach.
Correlates message(s): Message_ClientResponded.

Flow:
  Start: none event "Case ready for review"
  User task "Underwriter review" (assignee =caseOwnerUserId)
  Exclusive (XOR) gateway "Needs second sign-off?"
    ├─[Over threshold]
      User task "Second underwriter sign-off" (groups senior-underwriters)
      Event-based gateway "Wait for outcome"
        ├─[→]
          Catch message event "Client responds" (message "Message_ClientResponded")
          End: none event "Decision recorded"
        ├─[→]
          Catch timer event "SLA window" (timeDuration=PT48H)
          Service task "Escalate SLA breach" (job type "escalate-sla-breach")
          End: none event "SLA breached"
    ├─[Under threshold]
      → Wait for outcome (already described)

Boundary events (interrupts / error handling):
- timer event "Case SLA expired" (timeDuration=P5D) on "Underwriter review" routes to Handle case SLA breach

decisions.name: Affordability Band
decisions.description:
DMN decision "Affordability Band" (id: affordability-band): decision table with hit policy UNIQUE, 3 rule(s). Inputs: Monthly Income, Existing Debt Ratio. Outputs: Affordability Band.
Rules (when -> then):
  [Monthly Income, Existing Debt Ratio] -> [Affordability Band]
  1. when (>= 5000, < 0.3) then ("HIGH")
  2. when ([2000..5000), < 0.5) then ("MEDIUM")
  3. when (-, -) then ("LOW")

decisions.name: Override Precedence
decisions.description:
DMN decision "Override Precedence" (id: override-precedence): decision table with hit policy PRIORITY, 3 rule(s). Inputs: Manual Override Requested, Has Sanctions Flag. Outputs: Final Decision. Depends on decision(s): risk-flags.
Rules (when -> then):
  [Manual Override Requested, Has Sanctions Flag] -> [Final Decision]
  1. when (-, true) then ("DECLINE")
  2. when (true, false) then ("MANUAL_REVIEW")
  3. when (false, false) then ("PROCEED")

decisions.name: Risk Flags
decisions.description:
DMN decision "Risk Flags" (id: risk-flags): decision table with hit policy COLLECT, 3 rule(s). Inputs: Affordability Band, County Court Judgment Count, Sanctions Hit. Outputs: Risk Flag. Depends on decision(s): affordability-band.
Rules (when -> then):
  [Affordability Band, County Court Judgment Count, Sanctions Hit] -> [Risk Flag]
  1. when ("HIGH", -, -) then ("AFFORDABILITY_HIGH_RISK")
  2. when (-, >= 1, -) then ("CCJ_ON_FILE")
  3. when (-, -, true) then ("SANCTIONS_HIT")

decisions.name: Fee Waiver
decisions.description: DMN decision "Fee Waiver" (id: fee-waiver) is a literal expression: requestedAmount > 500000 and affordabilityBand = "HIGH".

decisions.name: Pricing Tier
decisions.description:
DMN decision "Pricing Tier" (id: pricing-tier): decision table with hit policy FIRST, 3 rule(s). Inputs: Affordability Band, Requested Amount. Outputs: Interest Rate Tier.
Rules (when -> then):
  [Affordability Band, Requested Amount] -> [Interest Rate Tier]
  1. when ("HIGH", > 100000) then ("PREMIUM")
  2. when ("HIGH", -) then ("STANDARD_PLUS")
  3. when (-, -) then ("STANDARD")
